title: World Geography & Wonders
subject: Geography & Earth
description: Explore countries, capitals, continents, grand monuments, and natural world wonders.

questions.question: How many continents are there on planet Earth?
questions.fact: The 7 continents are Asia, Africa, North America, South America, Antarctica, Europe, and Australia!

questions.question: What is the largest ocean on Earth by surface area?
questions.fact: The Pacific Ocean covers more area than all the continents combined!

questions.question: Which is the tallest mountain peak above sea level in the world?
questions.fact: Mount Everest rises 8,848.86 meters (29,031.7 feet) high in the majestic Himalayas.

questions.question: What is the longest river in the world?
questions.fact: The Nile River stretches over 6,650 km (4,132 miles) through northeastern Africa.

questions.question: In which country can you visit the ancient Pyramids of Giza and the Sphinx?
questions.fact: The Great Pyramid of Giza was built thousands of years ago for Pharaoh Khufu.

questions.question: What is the capital city of France?
questions.fact: Paris is known as the 'City of Light' and is home to the world-famous Eiffel Tower.

questions.question: Which country is both a continent and an island nation?
questions.fact: Australia is completely surrounded by ocean water and spans an entire continent.

questions.question: What is the largest hot desert in the world?
questions.fact: The Sahara Desert in North Africa covers about 9.2 million square kilometers!

questions.question: Which ancient stone monument in England is aligned with the summer solstice sunrise?
questions.fact: Stonehenge's giant standing stones were placed between 3000 and 2000 BCE.

questions.question: Which is the most populous country in the world?
questions.fact: India has over 1.4 billion residents, making it the most populous nation.

questions.question: Which iconic wall stretches thousands of miles across northern China?
questions.fact: The Great Wall was built over several dynasties to guard historic borders.

questions.question: Which continent is the coldest, windiest, and driest on Earth?
questions.fact: Antarctica is covered by an ice sheet holding 90% of the world's ice and 70% of fresh water.

questions.question: What is the capital city of Japan?
questions.fact: Tokyo is the bustling capital of Japan and one of the world's most vibrant technology hubs.

questions.question: What massive coral reef system off Australia's coast is visible from space?
questions.fact: The Great Barrier Reef is composed of over 2,900 individual reefs and 900 islands!

questions.question: In which continent is the Amazon Rainforest primarily located?
questions.fact: The Amazon Rainforest covers much of northwestern Brazil and neighbor nations in South America.

questions.question: What is the imaginary line around the middle of Earth dividing Northern and Southern hemispheres?
questions.fact: The Equator receives direct sunlight all year round, giving it warm tropical climates.
